title: 7 Best Herbal Tinctures For Over Bleeding During Periods
intro: Herbal tinctures for over bleeding during periods are natural remedies extracted from plants, which are used to treat excessive menstrual bleeding, also known as menorrhagia. Some of the commonly used herbal tinctures for over bleeding during periods include cramp bark, to ease cramps and reduce bleeding, shepherd's purse, which helps to stop bleeding due to its astringent properties, and blue cohosh, which is known to reduce menstrual flow and alleviate pain. Additionally, other herbal tinctures such as ginger, vitex, and licorice root are also used to treat over bleeding during periods, as they help to balance hormones, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation, ultimately leading to a reduction in menstrual bleeding.
